name: 71 Lager
desc: Crisp golden lager with soft bready malt, gently spicy Saaz hops and a refreshing finish.

name: Cider with Raspberry
desc: Somerset cider apples blended with raspberry juice. Juicy berry, fresh apple and a gently tart finish.

name: Airspace
desc: Smooth, creamy dark stout with roasted malt, coffee and cocoa notes.

name: Fridge Over Troubled Water
desc: Clean, crisp lager texture with a brighter hop aroma and firmer finish than a classic lager.

name: Peggy’s Drift
desc: Deep, toasty and balanced, with a smooth nitro pour and soft roast.

name: Feeling Strangely Fine
desc: Cloudy golden double IPA with an orange-led impression in a draught tasting and a fuller body.

name: Six Summers
desc: Ripe mango, passionfruit and guava. Citra and Strata hops in Amity’s sixth-birthday beer.

name: Leith Juice
desc: Bright grapefruit and orange zest, with a tropical edge from Simcoe and Cascade.

name: Black
desc: Creamy dark stout with roasted coffee, dark chocolate and a clean bitterness from Target and Goldings.

name: Waterpistol
desc: Hazy, juicy and easy-drinking, with a bright tropical hop character.

name: Even Bigger Boat
desc: Ripe pineapple, mango and lychee over a silky body, with bright citrus and a warming finish.

name: Easy Landing
desc: Soft, hazy and fruit-forward with a rounded finish.

name: Alpha Beta
desc: Grapefruit on the nose, juicy tropical hops on the palate and a light, easy finish.

name: Wokka Wokka
desc: Hazy pale with bright citrus from Citra Cryo and a piney, resinous edge from Chinook Cryo.

name: Jakehead
desc: Amber IPA with bold American hop aromas, a rounded malt body and firm bitterness.

name: Velocity Never Exceed
desc: Citrus peel, pine and a dry, firmly bitter finish.
